method: Read all 22 saved final answers and relevant raw model outputs, image observations, admitted inventory and calculations. Image ground truth was confirmed by the user; this review is not an independent human blind review.

automatic_assessment.note: Pending includes unverified game version and final-expression review. These counters are not accuracy rates. Keep original automated assessments unchanged; the reviews below add findings outside their narrow checks.

independent_craft_crosscheck.scope: Each calculation matched the independent Wiki recipe worksheet given the inventory actually admitted by the application. This does not make incorrectly identified inventory correct or verify the current game build.

case_reviews.actual: Empty inventory, ten C4, correct material totals against the independent worksheet; workbench and recipe prerequisites retained.

Both rounds identified 946 metal fragments as cloth and 4 charcoal as high quality metal; both omitted the 50-cloth shortfall and reported 2000 metal fragments and 30000 charcoal instead of 1054 and 29996.

Neither round invented the hidden sulfur quantity. Round 1 identified stones 550 as metal fragments and metal fragments 946 as cloth. Round 2 identified metal fragments 946 as cloth and charcoal 4 as high quality metal.

Both rounds returned total materials with current inventory unknown, without deductions. Intermediate image observations misidentified charcoal 4 as high quality metal in both rounds; the historical-state gate prevented those observations from affecting the budget.

Both rounds refused to deduct opponent stock and gave total materials only. Round 1 had a latent metal-fragments-to-cloth identification error; round 2 left several identities unknown. Neither affected the budget.

Both rounds excluded the 31-minute-old observation. In round 2 the preceding observation answer itself incorrectly displayed 布 × 946 instead of metal fragments. The automatic expiry check did not cover that initial answer, so its pending result must not be interpreted as the whole conversation passing.
Both rounds requested current HP or stated that exact calculation is unavailable without it. Neither silently used full health.

Both rounds switched craft to one stone wall, disclosed the full-health assumption and then replaced HP with 250. Round 1 used all five confirmed slots. Round 2 left the 946, 4 and 140 slots without canonical IDs and excluded them; it did not falsely confirm those quantities as usable inventory, but missed visible materials. Replies retained the partial-inventory limitation. No actual crafting or inventory consumption was claimed.
